title: Snow
hook: 外面下起了大雪，佩奇和乔治在雪地里踩脚印、打雪球，还堆了一个漂亮的大雪人。

cells.q: Why are Peppa and George so excited?
cells.a: They are very excited because they can play in the snow.
cells.cn: 他们特别兴奋，因为能去雪地里玩。

cells.q: What is the weather like outside?
cells.a: It is very cold, so they must wrap up warm.
cells.cn: 外面很冷，他们必须穿得暖暖的。

cells.q: What did Peppa make in the snow?
cells.a: She made a snowball to play with George.
cells.cn: 她做了一个雪球，和乔治一起玩。

cells.q: What did Mummy Pig say about their game?
cells.a: She said this game is getting a little too rough.
cells.cn: 她说这个游戏玩得有点太过火了。

cells.q: What are Peppa and George making?
cells.a: They are making a snowman, starting with the body.
cells.cn: 他们在堆雪人，先从身体堆起。

cells.a: Peppa uses the stones for the snowman's eyes and mouth.
cells.cn: 佩奇用石头做雪人的眼睛和嘴巴。

cells.q: What did George find for the snowman?
cells.a: He found some clothes to keep the snowman nice and warm.
cells.cn: 他找来一些衣服，让雪人暖暖的。

cells.q: What did Daddy Pig think of the snowman?
cells.a: He said it is the best snowman he has ever seen.
cells.cn: 他说这是他见过的最棒的雪人。

cells.a: He couldn't find his hat, his scarf and his gloves.
cells.cn: 他找不到自己的帽子、围巾和手套了。

helper.order: First / Next / Then / After that / Finally
helper.keywords: snow, cold, snowball, snowman, stones, clothes
helper.actions: play, make, throw, find, put on, wear

opener: Today I watched Peppa Pig. This episode is “Snow”.
ending: In the end, the snowman is wearing Daddy's hat, scarf and gloves. My favourite part is ______.
